title: Warm Canadian Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting casserole inspired by Canadian flavors. This dish is perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: 2. Cook the ground beef in a pan over medium heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
3. Add chopped onion and sliced pepper to the pan and cook until the vegetables are soft.
4. In a separate saucepan, make the bechamel sauce by melting 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat.
5. Whisk in 2 tablespoons of all-purpose flour and cook for 1 minute.
6. Slowly add in 1 cup of milk, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
7. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until it thickens.
8. In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked ground beef mixture, cubed bread, and shredded cheese.
9. Pour the bechamel sauce over the top and mix until well combined.
10. Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and cover with aluminum foil.
11. Bake for 25 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
